title: ToolSpec
description: Declarative ToolSpec schema defining all 16 specification attributes for Kairo agent tools.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tool (e.g., shell.run.v1, kali.exec.v1)

binary.description: Executable command path, name, or internal protocol handler

category.description: Classification category (e.g., execution, sandbox_execution, utility, diagnostic)

capabilities.description: Array of capability tokens declaring functionality

inputs.description: Schema definition of accepted input parameters, types, defaults, and requirements

outputs.description: Schema definition of generated output fields, formats, and artifacts

side_effects.description: Declared external side effects (e.g., filesystem modifications, network traffic)

privilege.description: Required privilege level for tool execution

gui.description: GUI requirement flag or GUI display configuration

parser.description: Output parser identifier or parser configuration specification

prerequisites.description: Required runtime dependencies, host binaries, or environment capabilities

docs.description: Embedded reference documentation, usage guide, and examples

success_signals.description: Signals, exit codes, and output patterns indicating successful execution

failure_signals.description: Signals, error codes, and patterns indicating failure or abort conditions

rollback.description: Rollback capability declaration, strategy, or compensating command

version_compatibility.description: Supported runtime version matrix, OS compatibility, or min agent version

name.description: Human-friendly display name of the tool

version.description: Semantic version of the tool specification

description.description: Detailed human-readable summary of the tool

timeout_ms.description: Default timeout in milliseconds before execution terminates
